comments:
Commentary on the Mūlamadhyamakakārikā (ID:3715) by a scholar familiar with the tools of epistemology. 
The author refers to the views of several scholars; some are identified by name in glosses in instance (ID:4606), notably Pha tshab (ID:3868) (ex019072025-12-0312-21-36, ex019072025-12-0312-29-45 , etc.) - whom the author criticizes - Gangs pa she'u (ID:3810) ex019072025-12-0312-29-51 , "chos rje paNTita" (ID:3892) ex019072025-12-0312-29-44 , and a yet unidentified "rtsang" ex019072025-12-0312-29-43 , maybe the same person identified as "rtsang nag" (ex019072025-12-0312-21-46, ex019072025-12-0315-38-24 ) , presumably gTsang nag pa (ID:3839)  , or maybe gTsang nags phugs pa (ID:6640), who is elsewhere referred to as "kho bo'i rjes 'dzin dag" ex019072025-12-0312-29-50 .
